zoe@redwood: Heads-up: playground smoke failed on our observability quickstart.
marco@redwood: what failed?
zoe@redwood: python snippet import is wrong and the dashboard YAML has a stray dash, so preview build fails.
sam@redwood: i'll update the TS examples after python is fixed.
kai@redwood: can we keep a short-term alias in the SDK for old param name (trace_key) and call it out in docs? less friction for customers.
marco@redwood: ok i'll open a single PR to fix python + yaml + ts snippets.
docs-bot: Draft PR created 7https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6233 by marco@redwood
marco@redwood: pushed python import fix and yaml cleanup.
sam@redwood: pushed TS updates and small migration note. running snippet runner locally.
docs-bot: CI checks started: build, snippets-smoke, preview
kai@redwood: added a short CHANGELOG entry for the param alias and filed a follow-up to remove alias in 2 releases.
marco@redwood: CI green, merging.
docs-bot: PR 6233 merged 7https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6233
zoe@redwood: thanks all 680
